title: container --filter ancestor panics
body:
### Issue Description

`buildah containers --filter ancestor=<name>:<tag>` panics when a listed container's image name has no `:`

`imageNameForID` in `cmd/buildah/containers.go` returns a name without `:` in
the following cases:
1. `scratch`: the placeholder name for a container created with `buildah from scratch`.
2. `""`: the image has no names (e.g. `buildah commit $ctr_id)`.


### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1.`CTR_NAME=$(buildah from ubuntu)`
2. `CTR_ID=$(buildah commit -q $CTR_NAME)`
3.`buildah from $CTR_ID`
4. `buildah containers --filter ancestor=:latest`

comments.body:
@Luap99 and @mheon  I need your opinions on this.

## History

No commit or issue ever defined what an ancestor value may look like. The filter was meant to mirror `podman ps`.

| Date | Commit / issue | What it did |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2018-01-31 | `85a37b39e` ([#437](https://github.com/containers/buildah/pull/437)) | `--filter` to `buildah containers` was added and reused `matchesReference` for `ancestor`. Docs: `[ImageName] Image or descendant used to create container`, one example `ancestor=ubuntu`.|
| 2018 | [#424](https://github.com/containers/buildah/issues/424) | Asked for `--format`/`--filter`. @rhatdan  suggested to have a similar filter as in  `podman ps --filters`. |
| 2017-06-21 | `6d85cd3f7` ([#155](https://github.com/containers/buildah/pull/155)) | Added `matchesReference` for `buildah images`, with the 4 unit tests that exist today (name, and name:tag, against `gcr.io/pause:latest`). |

Currently, the ancestor filter value is never validated and the docs were not very precise. Also, I didn't find bats tests for `--filter ancestor` to give me a better understanding what exact format we support. So I looked at Podman and Docker to see what they're doing.

## Docker and Podman and Buildah

Docker defines a strict format, Podman matches a regex anywhere, Buildah matches a suffix.

|  | Docker `ps` | Podman `ps` | Buildah today |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Documented values | `image`, `image:tag`, `image:tag@digest`, short ID, full ID ([docs](https://github.com/docker/cli/blob/66786b775ad2f71a4f6de79965a6f3d2efb08852/docs/reference/commandline/container_ls.md?plain=1#L209-L218)) | `[ImageName]` ("accepts regex") ([docs](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/a5d52f17b9fa23de912c6ba14159537d67a54852/docs/source/markdown/options/filter.container.md?plain=1#L25)) | `[ImageName]` ([docs](https://github.com/containers/buildah/blob/665f17a998f14ccc16442e0f06d23940ffb6e981/docs/buildah-containers.1.md?plain=1#L31)) |
| Name match | No string match: the value is resolved with an image lookup (`GetImage`), then containers are compared by image ID ([lookup](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/6721b5229b665f4d4d7bf40d759ee5445e6027c2/daemon/list.go#L334-L353), [compare](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/6721b5229b665f4d4d7bf40d759ee5445e6027c2/daemon/list.go#L539-L546)) | Unanchored regex on the full name ([code](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/a5d52f17b9fa23de912c6ba14159537d67a54852/pkg/domain/filters/containers.go#L134-L137), [`StringMatchRegexSlice`](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/a5d52f17b9fa23de912c6ba14159537d67a54852/pkg/util/utils.go#L153-L161)) | Suffix of the name part ([code](https://github.com/containers/buildah/blob/665f17a998f14ccc16442e0f06d23940ffb6e981/cmd/buildah/images.go#L355-L367)) |
| No tag given | Docker turns `ubuntu` into `ubuntu:latest`, looks up that image (ID aaa…), and keeps containers whose image ID is aaa…, plus images built from it. It never compares tags. `ubuntu:24.04` matches only because `24.04` happens to be the same image as `latest` right now. ([docs](https://github.com/docker/cli/blob/66786b775ad2f71a4f6de79965a6f3d2efb08852/docs/reference/commandline/container_ls.md?plain=1#L220-L221)) |  Podman checks whether the text `ubuntu` appears anywhere in the full name, tag included. So every row matches, even `myubuntu` and `ubuntu-dev`. ([code](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/a5d52f17b9fa23de912c6ba14159537d67a54852/pkg/domain/filters/containers.go#L123-L137)) | Buildah drops the tag and checks whether the name ends with `ubuntu`. `myubuntu` match. `ubuntu-dev` doesn't, because it ends with `-dev` ([code](https://github.com/containers/buildah/blob/665f17a998f14ccc16442e0f06d23940ffb6e981/cmd/buildah/images.go#L366)) |
| Tag-only `:latest` | Not documented; not a valid image reference to look up | Works (substring) | Works by accident; panics on `scratch` ([code](https://github.com/containers/buildah/blob/665f17a998f14ccc16442e0f06d23940ffb6e981/cmd/buildah/images.go#L362-L364)) |
| Digest | Supported, through the image lookup | Only if the stored name contains it | Only by luck |
| Image ID | Short or full, through the image lookup | Substring anywhere in the ID ([code](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/a5d52f17b9fa23de912c6ba14159537d67a54852/pkg/domain/filters/containers.go#L129-L132)) | Prefix ([code](https://github.com/containers/buildah/blob/665f17a998f14ccc16442e0f06d23940ffb6e981/cmd/buildah/images.go#L351-L353)) |
| Descendant images | Matched: walks child images ([code](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/6721b5229b665f4d4d7bf40d759ee5445e6027c2/daemon/list.go#L659-L672)) | Not matched | Not matched |
| Invalid value | Lookup failure logged as a warning; no container matches ([code](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/6721b5229b665f4d4d7bf40d759ee5445e6027c2/daemon/list.go#L338-L342)) | Invalid regex silently matches nothing ([code](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/a5d52f17b9fa23de912c6ba14159537d67a54852/pkg/util/utils.go#L155-L156)) | Never validated ([code](https://github.com/containers/buildah/blob/665f17a998f14ccc16442e0f06d23940ffb6e981/cmd/buildah/containers.go#L292-L293)) |


Sources: [docker ps docs](https://github.com/docker/cli/blob/master/docs/reference/commandline/container_ls.md), [podman filter code](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/main/pkg/domain/filters/containers.go), [podman filter docs](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/main/docs/source/markdown/options/filter.container.md).


## Edge cases

The image name compared is `imageNameForID` (`containers.go:138`), which can return seven forms:

|  | Image name | When you get it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | `docker.io/library/ubuntu:latest` | Pulled by tag |
| B | `localhost:5000/ubuntu:latest` | Pulled by tag from a registry with a port |
| C | `docker.io/library/ubuntu@sha256:…` | Pulled by digest |
| D | `localhost:5000/ubuntu@sha256:…` | Pulled by digest from a registry with a port |
| E | `docker.io/library/alpine:latest@sha256:…` | Copied straight into `containers-storage:` (e.g. `skopeo copy`) |
| F | `scratch` | `buildah from scratch` |
| G | `""` | `buildah commit` without a name |

Image-filter "boolean" table:

| Image | Filter | Today | Expected |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F `scratch` | `scratch:latest` or `:latest` | panic | no match |
| G `""` | `:latest` | panic | no match |
| B | `ubuntu`, `ubuntu:latest` | no match | match |
| C, D | `ubuntu` | no match | match |
| D | `ubuntu@sha256:…` | no match | match |
| E | `ubuntu:latest`, `ubuntu@sha256:…` | no match | match |
| C | `sha256:…` (bare digest) | match "by luck" | open question |
| B | `localhost:5000/ubuntu` | match "by luck" | match |

## Fix options

| # | Option | Panic fixed | Ports, digests | Behaviour change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | One-liner: `if len(splitName) > 1 && strings.Contains(argName, ":")` | Yes | No | None |
| 2 | Podman-style: regex on name, substring on ID | Yes | Yes | Substring instead of suffix. ID substring instead of prefix. Values become regexes |
| 3 | Docker-style: validate and split with `reference.Parse` | Yes | Yes | `:latest` and bare `sha256:…` rejected |
| 4 | split to name, tag, digest by hand (tag `:` must follow the last `/`). Bare `sha256:…` compared with the image digest | Yes | Yes | None. Tag-only `:latest` keeps working |

Rejected along the way: splitting at the last `:` only (breaks `localhost:5000/ubuntu` filters and digests), and `len(splitName) == 2` (stops `localhost:5000/ubuntu[:latest]` filters from matching).

cc: @rhatdan @umohnani8
